title: The video does not show or will not play
summary: The Video panel's status strip says what is wrong; the common causes are a hidden panel, a missing codec and no usable graphics decoder.
alternateQueries: Why does my video not play?

blocks.title: There is no video window
symptoms: no Video panel after pressing Play
blocks.resolution: The Video panel opens when Play is pressed with a video clip on the timeline. If it is open but behind another tab, Play brings it forward. Open it from View > Video.

blocks.title: Read the status strip
blocks.resolution: The strip under the picture reports the graphics state, the number of layers, pictures decoded and video clips under the playhead. "view not on screen: not decoding" means the panel is hidden. "DECODE PROBLEM: ..." gives the reason the picture could not be produced.

blocks.title: Windows could not open the file
symptoms: this container or codec may not be installed
blocks.resolution: Some containers and codecs (MKV, WebM, HEVC) need extra codecs in Windows. Convert the video to MP4 (H.264) and import it again.
blocks.cause: Video is decoded by Windows Media Foundation, which only opens formats Windows has decoders for.

blocks.title: No GPU decoder
symptoms: "could not start a Direct3D 11 GPU device"
blocks.resolution: Video decoding uses the graphics card. Update the graphics driver, and check that the video's codec is supported by your GPU.

blocks.title: The picture plays but there is no sound
blocks.resolution: The video's sound is extracted once after import and plays through its track. Check the track is not muted; if the sound was split onto its own track, check that track. A video with no sound track has nothing to play.
